messages:
jordan (support): FYI — customer sent a curl repro and some prompt text that looks like it contains PII (emails + phone). They gave request id req_9a4f2c and said it failed with 502s and high latency. Can security/privacy advise on safe redaction so we can forward a repro to eng?

sophia (security): Don't paste raw PII in channels. If you need to share the repro with eng, create a sanitized bundle and upload to the secure share link. We can accept placeholders like [EMAIL_REDACTED], [PHONE_REDACTED], [NAME_REDACTED]. Also need the original request id, timestamp, and the last 200 lines of the model server log (redacted).

jordan (support): Got it. Customer timestamp: 2026-03-15T14:22:10Z. Request id req_9a4f2c. They attached a curl in the ticket that includes an email in the prompt. Here's the raw-ish curl (redacted here but similar to what they sent):

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-..." \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-1","prompt":"Send confirmation to alice@example.com: Your code 12345"}'
```

sophia (security): Perfect example. Steps: 1) Replace any bearer tokens with [REDACTED_TOKEN]. 2) Replace emails and phones with placeholders. 3) Hash or truncate any account IDs (keep first 6 chars + "..."). 4) Never include full API keys or SSNs.

mike (eng): For repro we just need a minimal curl + the exact prompt text (sanitized). Also include the response body and the upstream server latency headers if present. If it's a 502 we need the model server trace id (trace_id header) and the gateway logs around the req.

jordan (support): Customer can run this helper on their side to collect a debug tarball (they already ran it, output: debug-req_9a4f2c-20260315.tar.gz). They asked how to sanitize before upload. Any quick commands?

sophia (security): Quick inline sanitize examples — run on *copy* of the files, never mutate originals. Examples: 

Replace emails:
```bash
perl -pe 's/[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}/[EMAIL_REDACTED]/g' raw_prompt.txt > prompt_sanitized.txt
```
Replace phone numbers (simple):
```bash
sed -E 's/\b(\+?\d[\d\-\s]{7,}\d)\b/[PHONE_REDACTED]/g' logs.txt > logs_sanitized.txt
```
Mask bearer tokens in headers:
```bash
sed -E 's/(Authorization:\s*Bearer)\s+\S+/\1 [REDACTED_TOKEN]/I' headers.txt > headers_sanitized.txt
```
Hash account ids (sha256 first 8 chars):
```bash
cat account_ids.txt | while read id; do echo "$id -> $(echo -n $id | sha256sum | cut -c1-8)"; done > account_ids_hashed.txt
```

angela (privacy): Please also remove any free-text customer notes that include names, addresses, or payment info. If the prompt is conversational and contains a full name + phone, replace both with [PERSON_REDACTED]. Keep an internal mapping in a separate file (only for our audit) if you need to trace back.

mike (eng): Once we get the sanitized bundle we can try to repro locally. If we still need the original for debugging we will request a secure upload to the private s3 path and get approval from privacy. But start with sanitized first.

jordan (support): Customer uploaded sanitized tar: s3://redwood-secure/support/customer-123/debug-req_9a4f2c-sanitized.tar.gz (shared via secure link). I downloaded and verified: prompt_sanitized.txt, headers_sanitized.txt, logs_sanitized.txt present.

devops-bot: New artifact uploaded by jordan: debug-req_9a4f2c-sanitized.tar.gz (size: 2.3MB) :lock:

mike (eng): Thanks — quick checklist from eng: please also include the exact curl command you used (with [REDACTED_TOKEN]) and the response body (sanitized). If you saw a 502, include the gateway request_id header and the model container stderr around that time. If you can reproduce locally with the sanitized prompt that’s ideal.

sophia (security): Small note — when sharing the sanitized tar in a ticket include this line in the ticket body: "I confirm all PII was replaced per Redwood's redaction policy v1.2" so we have an audit trail.

jordan (support): Will do. Customer confirmed they ran the perl/sed steps and re-uploaded. I added the confirmation line and attached the sanitized bundle. Moving to eng for repro.

mike (eng): Received. I'll try to repro and will ping here with a short log snippet. If we need any original fields we'll follow the privacy approval flow.

angela (privacy): Thanks team. Quick reminder: never forward the original bundle to public channels. Use secure share or the internal vault link.

jordan (support): Closing loop with customer now — thanks all :pray:
